mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "channel" gets the profile + live stream status. "videos" lists VODs/highlights/uploads. "clips" lists top or trending clips. "schedule" lists upcoming scheduled streams.

login.title: Channel login
login.description: A single Twitch channel login name (the part after twitch.tv/ in the URL, lowercase, e.g. "shroud").

logins.title: Channel logins
logins.description: Multiple Twitch channel login names to process in one run.

limit.title: Max items (videos / clips modes)
limit.description: Maximum number of videos or clips to return per channel. Twitch's own device-integrity gate blocks HTTP-only pagination beyond a single page, so this is capped at 100 (the most recent, or most-viewed, items -- not the full archive on channels with more).

videoType.title: Video type (videos mode)
videoType.description: Which kind of videos to list.

clipsPeriod.title: Clips time window (clips mode)
clipsPeriod.description: Only consider clips created within this time window.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many channels to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default. Not required for this endpoint (no WAF was found), but kept on for production robustness.
